info.description: Verification requests for Mistral resume embeddings.

exec: pm.test('Embedding configuration is required', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(503); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.errorCode).to.eql('EMBEDDING_NOT_CONFIGURED'); });

exec: pm.test('Embedding response has the configured dimension', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.model).to.eql('mistral-embed'); pm.expect(body.dimension).to.eql(1024); pm.expect(body.embedding).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(1024); pm.expect(body.embedding[0]).to.be.a('number'); });
